title: Stationery & email
slide_intent: Teach how to identify routine correspondence while keeping its message easy to read. Addresses, names and next actions have to remain findable.
strategic_value: The organization can carry its identity into a letter or email through a small mark, accent or signature while leaving most of the reading surface quiet.
demonstration: A formal letter and two-sided card sit on pink. An enlarged email on cyan shows the signature details, black wordmark, address and a small illustrated support prompt.
practical_value: Keep the letter body spacious and concentrate the identifying information in the header or signature. Check contact details independently of decorative graphics.

content_islands.name: Stationery
content_islands.spec: Place a white letter sheet and card faces on the pink half. Keep the right-aligned letterhead mark and compact card information visible.

content_islands.name: Email signature
content_islands.spec: Crop the email into the right field at a larger scale, showing the sign-off, name, details, mark, address and support link treatment.
